watch_paths.description: List of files or directories to monitor. Required positional arguments for fspy.

filter.description: Regex pattern to include paths; matched against full path.

inverted_filter.description: Regex pattern to exclude paths; inverted match.

recursive_depth.description: Enable recursive scanning up to this depth. 0 disables recursion.

adaptive.description: Enable adaptive mode to auto-add new paths to the watch list.

type_filter.description: List of element types to watch: 'f', 'd', 's', 'p', 'c', 'b', 'o'. Default (empty) means any.

output_format.description: List of output fields to include in event output. e.g. 'T', 'p', 'f', 'm' etc.
